column1: # The tutorial's worked examples: lines from OUTSIDE the reader, so a student meets each one fresh.
# A lesson shows one with <div class="demo" data-line="Met. 13.607" data-show="volucrī:u volucris:u">
# (see data/tutorial.json), and the app divides the named syllables with the zoom-in's animation.
# Text: Perseus Digital Library -- Ovid, ed. Hugo Magnus (1914); Vergil, ed. J. B. Greenough (1900),
# both public domain. Spelling brought to the reader's norm. Macrons: drafted by Alatius's
# latin-macronizer scanning each line as a hexameter, then proofread by hand, 2026-10-24 (it had
# written volūcrīs for volucris in Met. 13.607). Met. 1.21 and Aen. 6.878 (for the stage on two vowels
# side by side) were macronized by hand, 2026-10-26. Macrons are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, like the rest of data/.
# After any edit, rebuild the key the app reads:
# Keep a line's NEXT line beside it when the line runs on into it (Aen. 4.558-559, hypermetry):
# the scanner allows hypermetry only where the next line begins with a vowel.

column2: In nova fert animus mūtātās dīcere fōrmās
nec nova crēscendō reparābat cornua Phoebē,
lūcis egēns āēr: nūllī sua fōrma manēbat,
Hanc deus et melior lītem nātūra dirēmit.
ēmicuit summāque locum sibi fēcit in arce:
temperiemque dedit mixtā cum frīgore flamma.
Vix ita līmitibus dissaepserat omnia certīs,
iussit et ērēctōs ad sīdera tollere vultūs.
Aurea prīma sata est aetās, quae vindice nūllō,
Prōtinus irrūpit vēnae peiōris in aevum
cautus humum longō signāvit līmite mēnsor.
Ō utinam ā nostrō sēcēdere corpore possem!
Eurydicēs, ōrō, properāta retexite fāta.
et prīmō similis volucrī, mox vēra volucris
ātria; dēpendent lychnī laqueāribus aureīs
Conticuēre omnēs, intentīque ōra tenēbant.
mōnstrum horrendum, īnfōrme, ingēns, cui lūmen adēmptum.
omnia Mercuriō similis, vōcemque colōremque
et crīnīs flāvōs et membra decōra iuventā:
hoc opus, hic labor est. Paucī, quōs aequus amāvit
Heu pietās, heu prīsca fidēs, invictaque bellō
